title: Can Large Language Models Transform Computational Social Science?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models' zero-shot generative ability to infer and explain targeted demographic stereotypes in toxic text using the Social Bias Inference Corpus (SBIC), where models must generate free-text explanations of why a specific subgroup is targeted.

Measuring zero-shot classification performance (Macro F1) on the Ideological Books Corpus (utterance-level) and Article Bias Corpus (document-level) to detect liberal, conservative, and centrist ideological leanings in text.
